summary: The PR resolves the issue of ignoring files in recursive mode but introduces some readability and maintainability concerns.

issues.description: The addition of `_is_path_ignored` method breaks the encapsulation of the `PyLinter` class and makes the logic harder to follow.
The new methods `_discover_files` and `_is_path_ignored` deviate from the style and naming conventions used in the rest of the codebase.
